news.title: How to use MetaMask Buy option to put money inside your wallet
news.subtitle: MetaMask Portfolio get this Buy thing wey you fit use change your regular money (like Naira) to crypto for just a few clicks.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
MetaMask Portfolio get this Buy thing wey you fit use am buy crypto for easy with other people wey dey offer the service. Dem design am with you for mind, di Buy thing make everything easy and simple, you fit put money for your wallet with just few clicks.


Sellers wey dem approve


Instead make you dey limited to one person wey dey sell, MetaMask gather many different people wey dey sell wey we don check well well— to make sure them dey good—to give you the best price for your crypto wey you wan buy. To gather prices from different sources go give you plenty options to compare and select the one wey sweet you pass.

Prices wey dem fit make special for you


Everybody get different reasons why dem dey buy crypto and how them want pay. Na why we consider plenty things to give you price wey dey special for you.

  • Region: E dey available for people wey dey 189 different countries to use.
  • Way to Pay: The ways to pay go dey different depending on where you dey. Pick the way you wan pay: debit card or credit card, PayPal (U.S. except for Hawaii), Transfer money from bank, quick ACH, and oda local payment methods. More ways wey you fit pay go soon dey added.
  • Token: You fit buy over 90 different crypto things for more than 10 networks, like Ethereum, Polygon, Optimism, Arbitrum, Binance Smart Chain, Avalanche, Fantom, and Celo, plus some more.
  • Amount: Depending on di area wey you choose and their many KYC rules, how much you fit buy at once fit get limit.

Put money for your wallet sharp sharp


Your wallet balance go update by itself for MetaMask once you don buy am finish from the provider wey you buy am. You fit send money from any exchange straight to MetaMask now, no more waiting.

We dey welcome users wey just join from all over the world


Web3 dey everywhere, and we suppose welcome people to crypto like dat too. Since dem launch de aggregator, MetaMask dey try partner with people all over de world to help anyone, —no matter where you dey— to enter web3.

We want this thing to be the perfect place for new people wey just dey come into web3 so dem fit start to do oda important things.

How to use di Buy feature for MetaMask Portfolio


To put money for ya wallet:

  1. Link ya MetaMask wallet to portfolio.metamask.io
  2. Click di “Buy” tab to start am
  3. Pick ya area
  4. Pick how you wan pay
  5. Pick di coin and network wey you wan buy from (For example: ETH for Ethereum network)
  6. Put the amount you want in regular money (for example: $100 worth of ETH)
  7. All the prices from all the different people wey dey sell go show and pick one to move on.
  8. Dem go redirect you to their website, safe and sound, to finish de payment, and de funds go dey added for your MetaMask wallet.

Success! 🦊

For MetaMask Portfolio, the "Buy" thing wey dey there go allow you pump your wallet with any crypto wey you want, and you fit start to use am straight away. Whether you wan hold your ETH for profit, buy NFTs (special digital things you fit get), try out DeFi (decentralized finance), or even more things — you fit do all these things now with account wey get money inside.

Shey you don dey ready to enter? Sabi plenti for metamask.io/portfolio/.

MetaMask Portfolio: Carry eye see and watch over all your web3 kain kain things

MetaMask Portfolio na ogbonge platform wey dey easy to use and get all your web3 things for one place, e go help you control everything yourself. Whether you wan use Dashboard, Buy, Swap, Bridge, Stake, you dey safe. We dey always work hard to make the dapp better and better with updates wey go make sense. Press here to sabi more about MetaMask Portfolio and wetin e fit do.

image.title: How to swap crypto
image.description: How to swap crypto with MetaMask

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Swapping crypto is fast, easy, and secure with MetaMask. You can choose from thousands of your favorite tokens across nine networks including Ethereum, Linea, Base, and Arbitrum. MetaMask Swaps also include gas fees right in your quotes, making swapping crypto as smooth as can be.

We've simplified cross-chain swapping too. Send&Swap lets you choose the token you want to spend and the token you want the other person to receive — all in one move. As ever, safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets. So rest easy. MetaMask Swaps are powered by our razor-tight, industry-leading security.

Below, you'll find step-by-step guides showing you how to swap crypto with MetaMask.

Let’s get into it! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Extension

  1. Open the MetaMask browser extension.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, and click the Swap button.
  3. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  4. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  6. A preferred quote will be loaded automatically. To select a different quote, click View all quotes.
  7. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask App

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask mobile app.
  2. Select the network you want to swap on, located at the top of your screen. Example: Ethereum Mainnet.
  3. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  4. Tap Swap.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from by tapping the token name that appears under your wallet address. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Tap Get quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Tap Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

How to swap crypto with MetaMask Portfolio

  1. Connect your MetaMask wallet to portfolio.metamask.io
  2. Click Move crypto.
  3. Click Swap.
  4. Select the network you want to swap from in the dropdown menu. Example: Ethereum.
  5. Select the token you want to swap from. Example: ETH.
  6. Enter the amount that you want to swap.
  7. Select the token you want to swap to. Example: DAI.
  8. Click Get Quotes to proceed. Note: you can manually select a different quote from our range of industry-leading providers.
  9. Click Swap to confirm.

Success! 🦊

Ready to start swapping crypto? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask app for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide about swapping crypto.

nodes.subtitle: MetaMask Portfolio get this Sell thing wey dey allow you sell your crypto and get money from people wey MetaMask don check well well, with just small clicks.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
MetaMask Portfolio get this Sell thing wey allow you to change your crypto to regular money (like Dollar, Euro, and Pound) with no stress. Combined with di Buy function, e fit make you be your own boss for web3 experience with less middlemen and quick conversion to normal money straight to where you wan am, like your bank account or PayPal balance if e dey available


Crypto sellers wey dem approve


Instead to limit to one provider, MetaMask gather many providers wey dey trusted (many of dem dey de same ones for de [Buy] (http://portfolio.metamask.io/buy?utm_source=metamask&utm_medium=blog&utm_campaign=feature-articles_content) flow)—make sure dem meet our high standards—to show you different options wey dey available in real-time to change your ETH on Ethereum Mainnet to de normal money wey you choose (where dem dey available).

People from all over de world


You fit sell things now for the US (but some states get their own rules), UK, and some places for Europe, but dem get plan to extend am to more places to help our people all over di world. Na important thing for people to fit freely buy and sell crypto, and we hope say these ways go make web3 reach plenty more people. We dey start with support for ETH for Ethereum Mainnet, but soon, we go fit get even more kain kain tokens wey them dey use for gas for those levels wey dey on top of the main network (layer 2), and even normal money like US Dollar (USD), Euro (EUR), and British Pound (GBP).

How to use di Sell Crypto feature for MetaMask Portfolio:


To sell ya crypto for money:

  1. Connect ya MetaMask wallet to portfolio.metamask.io
  2. Press di “Sell” tab to start am
  3. Pick ya area
  4. Pick di crypto and network wey you wan sell from (For example: ETH for Ethereum network)
  5. Pick the account wey you wan make your money enter for your area (for example: bank account or PayPal account wey you get money for inside)
  6. Put the amount of crypto wey you wan sell (example: 0.5 ETH)
  7. All the prices from all the different people wey dey sell go show right now. Pick one make you kontinu.
  8. Dem go send you safely go the website of the person wey dey sell to register and connect your regular money account, then send you back go MetaMask Portfolio.
  9. Pick "Send ETH to [Provider]" to move your crypto from your wallet to your bank account.
  10. Confam di transaction for ya MetaMask wallet.
  11. You go fit monitor your order as e dey process for di "Sell" place. Each person wey dey sell get their own time, and your money fit take some days to show for your normal bank account.

Success! 🦊

E dey aligned with oga/madam wey dey sell am


With the Buy and Sell ting for your MetaMask Portfolio, you fit buy and sell your crypto and cash with many of the same people wey you don know already. E mean say you go only need to sign-up and connect your bank account one time with one particular oga/madam wey dey sell. We hope say you go like to dey use dis features.

Shey you don dey ready to enter? Sabi plenti for metamask.io/portfolio/.

MetaMask Portfolio: Carry eye see and watch over all your web3 kain kain things

MetaMask Portfolio na ogbonge platform wey dey easy to use and get all your web3 things for one place, e go help you control everything yourself. Through Dashboard, Buy, Swap, Bridge, Stake, you dey safe. We dey always work hard to make the dapp better and better with updates wey go make sense. Press here to sabi more about MetaMask Portfolio and wetin e fit do.

childMarkdownRemark.html:
Wondering how to buy crypto, but not sure where to start? You’ve come to the right place. Buying crypto with MetaMask is speedy, simple, and safe.

You can buy crypto straight into MetaMask using payment methods like a credit card, debit card, bank account, Apple Pay, Google Pay, or PayPal. No need for centralized exchanges. Select from thousands of your favorite tokens on over 15 networks including Ethereum, Linea, Base, and more. The choice is yours.

We're driven by making the process of buying crypto quick and cost-effective. So we've cut out all of the unnecessary steps – saving you time, and money on excess fees too.

We also know that safety is essential when it comes to your digital assets. MetaMask is the most secure crypto wallet for good reason. Our security is industry-leading and razor-tight, so you can buy (and sell, swap, stake, and bridge) with peace of mind. And if you need help along the way, our 24/7 support team is always here to assist around-the-clock.

Below, you'll find videos and step-by-step guides showing you how to buy crypto with MetaMask on your browser or mobile app.

Let's get into it! 🦊

How to buy crypto with MetaMask Extension

Clicking the Buy & Sell button on the MetaMask extension will redirect you to MetaMask Portfolio. Once there, connect your MetaMask wallet.

  1. Click Move crypto.
  2. Click Buy.
  3. Select your region, and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  4. Select the crypto token, and network that you want to buy on. Example: ETH on Ethereum.
  5. Enter the amount you want to buy. Example: 0.5 ETH Example: $100 of ETH.
  6. Select the payment method you want to use to buy crypto. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal balance. Availability will depend on your region.
  7. Select the best real-time quote from our industry-leading providers.
  8. You'll be securely redirected to the provider's website to complete the purchase, and funds will be deposited into your MetaMask wallet.

Success! 🦊

How to buy crypto with MetaMask app

  1. Sign-in to your MetaMask app.
  2. Tap the menu button, which has two arrows in opposite directions and is located on the bottom of your homepage screen.
  3. Tap Buy.
  4. Select your region and currency — located to the right of your wallet address.
  5. Select the crypto token, and network that you want to buy on. Example: ETH on Ethereum.
  6. Enter the amount you want to buy. Example: 0.5 ETH.
  7. Select the payment method you want to use to buy crypto. Example: debit card, credit card, bank account, or PayPal balance. Availability will depend on your region.
  8. Tap Get quotes to proceed. Select the best quote from our industry-leading providers.
  9. Complete the transaction on the provider’s portal, and link your desired payment method.
  10. Review the order summary in your MetaMask app, and confirm the transaction to get crypto in your wallet.

Success! 🦊

Ready to get started? If you’re on desktop, download MetaMask Extension. If you’re on mobile, download MetaMask app for iOS or Android.

Need more help? We got you. Check out our MetaMask Support guide about buying crypto
